journey.name: send direct channel funding
journey.description: Requires two compatible wallets and a primary on the same regtest chain. The sender has one confirmed onchain coin covering 20000 sats plus the 1000-sat fee ceiling, with automatic primary funding paused or no configured primary. Obtain a real signed URI from the receiver. Repeat for fresh-channel and splice receiving with LDK and Beignet providers. Android-only feature.

actions.action: Open the receiver's fresh 20000 sat Bitcoin URI in the sender through its bitcoin deep link
If Lightning is selected, open the source selector and choose Direct channel funding (testTag "SendFundingSourceDirectFunding")
Continue to confirmation and tap Show Details (testTag "SendConfirmToggleDetails")

Verify the Direct channel funding label and the receiver node ID (testTag "DirectFundingReceiver"); scroll within the expanded details as needed and verify a maximum network fee of 1000 sats (testTag "DirectFundingMaximumFee")
Cancel before swiping and verify neither wallet has a new direct-funding activity
Open the same request again, select Direct channel funding, review and swipe to pay
Verify the sender shows success only after the funding transaction is observed, or shows a pending result while its outcome is unresolved
Reopen the same request while pending and verify it opens the existing result without offering another send or a Lightning fallback

Mine the funding transaction and refresh both wallets; verify exactly one sent direct-funding activity and exactly one incoming channel-credit activity for 20000 sats, with no own-wallet funding-transfer debit on the receiver
Restart both wallets and verify the same confirmed activity records remain, then open the request again and verify no second payment is sent
Open a copy with an empty or repeated bgnq parameter and verify it is rejected without payment confirmation or fallback
Repeat request entry on a sender with only channel balance and no confirmed onchain coin; verify Direct channel funding cannot be submitted
